title: The regularization penalty must be echoed by the LibRPA driver dump
symptom: The analytic continuation is supposed to use a 1e-12 Tikhonov penalty, but if the build does not parse regularization the run silently uses 0 and nothing in the numbers looks wrong.
root_cause: The input key is regularization; LibRPA ignores keys it does not know. The audited builds (LibRPA-v0.7.0-dd169fa1, librpa-metallic-unified-20261026, master_ghj) expose the Tikhonov argument only through TFGrids::generate_minimax(..., regulation) -> get_minimax_grid -> gx_minimax_grid_wrp (commit 5711b2cb) and their options structs did not show an input field, so the build must prove it parsed the key.
minimal_fix: Write regularization = 1e-12 in librpa.in (the oml template and production defaults do). The stage gate librpa.input.penalty_echo requires the LibRPA driver parameter dump to echo regularization = 1e-12; if the dump lacks it, the build ignored the key and the run must not be accepted.
validation: Run one 16-point continuation; grep the LibRPA rank-0 output for 'regularization = 1e-12'. The oml stage gate checks the same line. A model comparison must pair 0 and 1e-12 with every other key identical.
avoid: Do not accept a run because the input contains regularization; only the driver dump proves the build read it. Do not use a guessed alias such as regulation for the input key.
source: user instruction 2026-10-28 (解析延拓改为加惩罚项，系数 1e-12，n_params_anacon=-1 用 nfreq 个点); LibRPA commit 5711b2cb; source audit of LibRPA-v0.7.0-dd169fa1, librpa-metallic-unified-20261026 and master_ghj

parameters.semantics: -1 uses all nfreq points for the analytic continuation
